title: D-JEPA: A Decision-Aligned Latent World Model
titleZh: D-JEPA：决策对齐的潜在世界模型
short_description: D-JEPA aligns latent world models with the decisions they support. It learns decision-relevant relations among candidate futures from executed outcomes, combines evidence across complementary predictive models, and realizes the learned ordering in future representations. The framework improves action selection across manipulation, physical robots, and autonomous driving.
shortDescriptionZh: D-JEPA 让潜在世界模型的未来预测更好地服务于动作选择。方法从实际执行结果中学习候选未来之间的决策关系，融合互补预测模型的信息，并将学习到的排序写入未来表征，从而改进机器人操作、真实机器人与自动驾驶中的决策。
